blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — An incumbent barangay kagawad (village councilor) was arrested in a drug sting in Paoay, Ilocos Norte, the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) said on Saturday, Sept. 26. The suspect, identified only as alias “Al,” a resident of Barangay Valdez in Marcos town, was arrested in Barangay 13, Dolores, Paoay, during a joint operation by PDEA Ilocos Norte and police units on Wednesday, Sept. 23, Authorities seized three heat-sealed sachets containing suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) weighing about 2 grams, with a standard drug value of P13,600, along with the buy-bust money.
